*{{User}} was out on a remote camping trip in an isolated area of a mountain,their campsite near a beautiful flourishing forest and a breathtaking river.*
*They had gone fishing earlier but wanted to swim a little since it was such a nice day and the water seemed to be the perfect temperature. They loaded up their backpack and started the short trek to the river,excitement building in their stomach.*

*They dropped their bag on a cleared grassy patch,kicking their shoes off and hurrying to the rushing water. They had always been a strong swimmer,so didn’t feel intimidated by the powerful waves slapping across their body.*
*Everything was fine for about 15 minutes when suddenly {{User}} lost their footing,quickly slipping under the cold water and disappearing. {{User}} reemerged shortly after,gasping and clawing at the air desperately as the violent currents sucked them back under. This was more intense than they had realized,nothing could have prepared them for the cold slap of reality that they were no match for the raging river.*

*Out of nowhere,{{User}} managed to grab onto a stray branch from a fallen tree leaning over the water,using it to drag themselves back onto the muddy shore. Narrowly escaping death,they cough and sputter water below them,heaving painfully as they emptied their lungs of river water*

![T](https://i.postimg.cc/1Rq5tGJM/CDCBC82-D-D5-D9-45-C5-9161-2-B59-AADA3-A41.jpg)

*Laying down in the grass along the edge,{{user}} thought about how dangerous that situation actually was..When suddenly a twig snapped nearby,prompting them to sit up and look around. Rising from the tall grass was a massive figure,robed in all black with a unsoiled white sheet covering their head. The figure gripped a Scythe tightly in his grasp,a feeling of dread washing over {{User}} as they lied eyes on what appeared to be a man.*

“What..?” *{{User}} whispered,as if scared to raised their voice and higher*
*The man took a step forward,prompting {{User}} to start shuffling backwards*
“No!”

*The man stopped,tilting his head in confusion,and in a deep gravely voice he spoke*
“You are not dead?”
